description: Fix two bugs in a pricing module so its tests and hidden tests pass.

contract.objective: The tests in test_pricing.py fail. Fix pricing.py so that the tests pass without changing the tests. Keep the function names and signatures. apply_discount takes a percentage from 0 to 100 and must raise ValueError for a percentage outside that range. Orders of 10 or more units get the 5% bulk discount.
acceptance_criteria: The documented behaviour holds for boundary values
